_note: Every threshold the cockpit uses. status: provisional (starting value, the owner sets it from docs/CALIBRATION.md), set (the owner's number, with the date in source), fixed (a fact, not a choice).

silent_bead_hours.source: owner 2026-10-16: a mark, never a warning or notification ("(the owner's words)"); 12 h from docs/CALIBRATION.md; counts the holder's turns as work

beads_per_task_session.source: owner 2026-10-16: "eso debe ser de a 1 tarea"

blocker_ask_hours.source: owner 2026-10-16: show a blocker ask at once ("yes of course"); the asking session waits for the answer (panel 4c9041)

haiku_step_tokens.source: Anthropic pricing: Haiku 5.5 bills the whole request 5x above 100k prompt tokens

account_5h_mark_pct.source: the balancer's USAGE_LIMIT (pick_account.py); reread when it changes

autopilot_idle_minutes.source: docs/REQUIREMENTS.md autopilot rule 1 (phase 3); since pg-o1sq step 3 only for a session whose cache life is not known

keep_warm_probe_on.source: owner 2026-10-22, panel ask 4cf900 "A: yes, turn it on"; when true the autopilot types one short prompt into an idle session near its cache's expiry, up to the break-even count, and only at or under probe_max_spot_multiple of its sweet spot (the first project's decision log, 2026-10-22 keep-warm rules)

probe_max_spot_multiple.source: owner 2026-10-22 (the first project's keep-warm rules, e19cd7): no cache probe above this multiple of the session's sweet spot; used by the idle-cost replay and column, no probe is sent yet

probe_output_tokens.source: heuristic: a fixed short probe message answered in a few words; replace with the measured output of the first real probes

cache_expiry_margin_minutes.source: design pg-o1sq Q8 rows 5-7: with no TASK coming, compact this long before the cache expires (at most half a 5-minute cache); the 30 s read and the compaction's own turn fit inside it; calibrate from actions.jsonl compactions that landed after expiry

quality_cap_tokens.source: docs/COMPACTION.md: W_q, no cap until the owner sets one; owner 2026-10-16: "keep all three"

price_max_age_days.source: owner 2026-10-16: mark B, prices marked after 90 days or when a model has no price

turn_end_max_tokens.source: panels f68cd6 to b31e2b (2026-10-22): an Opus or Sonnet session is compacted at a finished turn once over its sweet spot, at most this; the replay of 7 days of transcripts put the cost bottom at 150k for 9 of 12 sessions (flat to 200k), -$39.68 a day against what happened

turn_end_gap_seconds.source: panels f68cd6 to b31e2b: idle this long after a request ends a turn; tool calls follow each other in a few seconds

turn_end_window_minutes.source: how long after a turn ends the turn-end compaction may still go out (a read held by a waiting control or a busy pane); later the expiry rule decides

haiku_guard_pct.source: the line a TASK arriving at a Haiku session is decided against (task_start); the idle guard rule that compacted at it was removed 2026-10-22 (panels f68cd6 to b31e2b), Claude Code's own window compacts Haiku under the step

hold_band_min_reviews.source: owner decision 767efc (pg-yn73): a context band with fewer reviews than this reads "not enough data"; the builder's starting number, set from how many reviews a band collects in 14 days

autopilot_on.source: owner 2026-10-16: the autopilot runs by itself ("debe ser autobalanceado") and Resume turns it on ("el autopilot automaticamente se pone true cuando le de a resume"): it stays true and the pause file is its switch, since a paused team gets nothing typed. false stops it for good, with no switch on the page

high_context_tokens.source: measured on the first project, Oct 15: about 70% of token use happens above 150k context

tokens_day_over_avg_pct.source: design chat LI11: a day 20% over the 7-day average lights the Tokens light

tokens_per_bead_rise_pct.source: design chat LI13: tokens per landed bead rising week over week

duplicate_window_minutes.source: design chat LI9: the same message body received again within this window is a duplicate (the project's WORKFLOW: one event, one message, one recipient)

jev_yes_probability.source: design chat J1: a Jev probability at or above this counts as yes in the fixed table; judged by the Jev record

start_load_share_pct.source: owner 2026-10-16: show what CLAUDE.md and the rest cost at session start; amber when the start load is this share of an average turn or more; calibrated from the transcripts

disk_min_free_gb.source: the first project's disk rule: under 30 GB free no build, test run or device boot starts

disk_watch_free_gb.source: a warning before the team's 30 GB floor stops builds; calibrated from how fast free space falls

doc_lag_days.source: pg-o1sq design Q13 'docs older than the code they describe': a doc a week behind a file it names is worth a look; set from how often the row lights once it has run a week

start_load_rise_pct.source: owner 2026-10-16: each role's start-load limit comes from its own usual over 14 days; the bar turns orange this much above it

recovery_idle_gap_minutes.source: docs/COMPACTION.md recovery cost R: a request after a longer gap is a new prompt or a cold cache, not recovery; same start as autopilot_idle_minutes, calibrate from the gaps after compactions

recovery_min_compactions.source: docs/COMPACTION.md recovery cost R: fewer compactions of a kind use the fleet value, marked provisional; 3 as the sweet spot's own last 3 cycles

context_boost.source: owner 2026-11-03, brain's chat: "(the owner's words)" (I want brain's sweet spot multiplied by 2x, arbitrarily; document that I chose it), then "autopilot me refiero" (I mean the autopilot). The owner's own pick, not measured; no end date. Multiplies brain's sweet spot, ceiling and turn line. Before: owner 2026-10-30, brain 2x and ai 3x for that day only (ended 2026-10-31).

mac_watch_free_pct.source: owner panel 848447 (Mac health light); macOS memory free % (kern.memorystatus_level) under which the Mac starts to swap hard; today 75

mac_act_free_pct.source: owner panel 848447; under 10% free macOS kills or freezes apps

orphan_min_hours.source: owner panel 848447; a one-shot tool or scratchpad process alive a day after launchd adopted it was left by a session (2026-11-05: a 23-day tail -F, a 23-day grep)
